settings.markdown:
## How it works
1. Join our Discord and say hello.
2. Tell us your RuneScape name; a recruiter invites you in game.
3. Visit the Citadel once a week if you can. That's it.

No level requirement, no XP target. Help out when you can and be kind.

items.q: Do I have to cap every week?
items.a: No. Cap when you can; the grid is there to celebrate it, not to chase anyone.
Donations pay for event prizes and giveaways. Totals are public, balances aren't.
Please do. Send them our Discord link.
